text:
alice-cs: Hey team — Moorland Therapeutics (MTRX) says they won't accept an invoice until we have an official PO and vendor onboarding complete. Invoice attempted: INV-2026-0042, currently in 'held' state. They pasted a procurement portal link and require our vendor form + W-9 + company bank details. :grimacing:
emily-support: Got it. Do we have any of those docs on file for MTRX already? Any prior customers with similar requirements?
jordan-sales: We sold them Dedicated capacity. Historically they require a PO for any >$5k spend. Sales collected a signed SOW but procurement is asking for a vendor ID (SAP vendor number) and a PO that includes their GL and cost center. They won't authorize payment without the PO.
sanjay-finance: System note from billing-bot shows invoice state: `held_pending_po`. Our policy normally requires an incoming PO to convert the pro-forma to a final invoice for enterprise customers. We can send a pro-forma but cannot finalize the tax invoice without PO metadata.
katie-procurement: What exact PO fields are they asking for? If it's just PO number + cost center we might be able to attach it after they provide it and then finalize. If they need vendor onboarding (supplier portal) that's a separate process on their side — they create our vendor entry in SAP, then give us a vendor ID. That can take 3–7 business days.
alice-cs: They pasted this in the portal note: "Required: PO number (format MTRX-YYYY-#####), GL code, cost center, signed SOW, W-9, bank details (ACH). Also require our company DUNS number or VAT ID for EU ops"
emily-support: Thanks. Two questions for the thread: 1) Can we accept a PO after issuing a pro-forma invoice to unblock their procurement system? 2) Is Finance willing to do an exception and accept payment or finalize invoice post-PO?
sanjay-finance: Short answer: we can issue a pro-forma invoice that marks the account as billable, but revenue recognition requires a final tax invoice. We need the PO attached before we mark the invoice as final in the accounting system. We can accept the PO after the fact and backdate, but only if the PO references the pro-forma number and SOW. We'll need a copy of their vendor onboarding confirmation if they require supplier validation.
legal-bot: Note: If the SOW includes data handling clauses for on-prem deployments, procurement may request an executed DPA as well. If DPA isn't signed we should flag the SOW to avoid legal exposure.
jordan-sales: Customer says they can provide PO within 48 hours if we provide a pro-forma and the correct PO reference (they want the SOW number and pro-forma). Can we create a pro-forma that includes the following snippet?
```
Pro-forma reference: PROFORM-INV-2026-0042
SOW ref: SOW-MTRX-019
Amount due: $62,400
Terms: Net 30 upon receipt of official PO and finalized invoice
```
katie-procurement: That's workable. Also ask them to include our legal company name exactly as: Redwood Inference, Inc. and tax id: XX-XXXXXXX in the vendor form. Offer to pre-fill the vendor form fields to speed up onboarding.
alice-cs: I'll send them a pre-filled vendor packet + W-9 + bank details and a pro-forma PDF with the snippet above. I'll also ask them to confirm the PO format (MTRX-2026-xxxxx) and where to upload the PO in the portal.
emily-support: Can you paste the portal upload URL here once you have it? I'll add a note to the ticket and set the invoice hold flag so billing doesn't auto-cancel.
sanjay-finance: Please assign the invoice to manual review. I'll provisionally approve sending a pro-forma but we must not mark revenue until PO is attached. If they want immediate service activation we can allow it (sales ok'd it), but capture acceptance in writing.
legal-bot: If they require data processing addendum, cc me and I'll queue the template for signature. Avoid sharing any raw customer PHI in the Slack thread.
billing-bot: Action logged: invoice INV-2026-0042 set to `on_hold: awaiting_po` by alice-cs at 1710045620.
jordan-sales: Customer follow-up: "we'll push PO once you submit pro-forma with SOW ref." I'll message them now.
alice-cs: Follow-up to customer sent. CC'd finance for PO attachment instructions. I'll upload the vendor packet to their portal and request confirmation once they've created our vendor ID.
emily-support: Thanks—keeping this open. If they escalate to procurement ops (Ariba/SAP), tag me and I'll pull the onboarding checklist. :thumbsup:
sanjay-finance: FYI — if we get the PO but no SAP vendor ID, accounting still needs a signed contract and PO to proceed. Add a note: required artifacts = [signed SOW, PO referencing pro-forma, W-9, bank details].
alice-cs: Noted. Closing slack thread once PO is attached to the billing ticket.
